query: We're adding wholesale customers to the shop in this project. Wholesale customers get 15% off, free shipping once the subtotal reaches 500, and promo codes don't apply to them. The checkout summary should show '(Wholesale)' for them, like it shows '(VIP)'. Please implement it.

Posts created before we added slugs have `slug = null`. Add `backfillSlugs(db: Db): Promise<void>` in src/backfill.ts that gives each of those posts a slug from its title, using our `slugify`. Slugs must be unique; there's a unique index on posts.slug. We'll run it against production tonight.

Make the product filters shareable. Add `filtersToQuery(filters: Filters): string` and `filtersFromQuery(query: string): Filters` in src/filtersUrl.ts. The page will write the query string whenever the filters change and read it on load, so a copied link restores the same view.
Add the logic for a 'Mark all as read' button: `Inbox.markAllRead(): Promise<void>` should tell the API about every unread notification in one call and clear the badge (`unreadCount`).

Add two shipping rules: GB postcodes in the Scottish islands (areas HS and ZE, and districts KW15 to KW17) cost an extra 15, and any parcel over 30 kg goes by freight at a flat 80, regardless of the other rules.
discount() and shipping() in src/pricing.ts keep growing special cases. refactor so each customer type's rules sit in one place, behaviour must stay exactly the same
in src/checkout.ts the summary should start with 'Client' instead of 'Customer'. just that text change please
what does shippingCost return for a 12 kg express parcel to France? just tell me, don't change anything
rename Inbox.list() to Inbox.unreadNotifications() everywhere it is used
add a unit test for formatMoney with GBP amounts in tests/money.test.ts
